premises.text: Combustion-based fossil power plants are inefficient, inflexible, and emit large amounts of CO2
premises.evidence_span: These combustion power plants fail. They are highly inefficient, they are not flexible, and they emit millions of tons of CO2

premises.text: Solid oxide fuel cells plus CO2 separation and methanation in a closed cycle eliminate combustion, achieve ~100% fuel conversion and 80% electric efficiency, and yield water and pure CO2
premises.evidence_span: By adding the two components that we showed before to the fuel cells and operating the system in a closed cycle, we achieve 100% fuel conversion and 80% electric efficiency

premises.text: System is reversible: can produce green hydrogen or renewable methane from excess grid power for long-term storage
premises.evidence_span: our new system design is reversible, meaning it can also produce gas from excess power

premises.text: First market is biogas plants: produce renewable power and separate biogenic CO2 when renewables are scarce, enabling negative emissions via long-term CO2 storage
premises.evidence_span: Biogas plants are our first target market

premises.text: Doubling electric efficiency plus reversible operation can more than fivefold customer income from electricity and related revenues
premises.evidence_span: the doubling in electric efficiency first of all means doubling revenues from electricity. With the additional revenues from the reversible operation, they can overall more than fivefold their income

value.text: Decentralized, carbon-negative, highly efficient power generation
value.evidence_span: provide the world with decentralized, carbon negative, and highly efficient power plants

secondary_value.text: Long-term renewable energy storage via reversible gas production

causal_links.evidence_span: They are highly inefficient, they are not flexible, and they emit millions of tons of CO2
Our solution produces power at a groundbreaking efficiency of 80%
Long-term storage of this biogenic CO2, in turn, enables negative CO2 emissions

notes: Process+performance of the closed-cycle plant (efficiency, no off-gas, pure CO2) folded into P2 per v1.5.1 #8. Container subsystem tour treated as cascade of that mechanism. Global market-scale vision not coded as a premise. Plug-and-play/carbon-negative claims folded into value and process premises.
